data.text: Place an impassable (for low-Matter creatures) adjacent wall token with power 20 × number of Creations cast. To destroy, enemy must emit Earth > wall/2× wall. + Put an Earth token on that tile.

natural_permanent.text: Monster natural permanent (Tangle Spider, Ember Weaver start with 2, power 6 each): enemies whose Matter is below the monster's cannot enter the hexes next to it. No hit points — it falls with the permanents (Rule 24, Matter). Players still cast Creation as an Earth obstacle.

logic.description: Implemented (2026-10-29). An Earth obstacle with 5 hp appears on the left-clicked adjacent free tile (else the free neighbour nearest the closest enemy). The caster's side walks over it; an enemy moving or aiming into it is held there and knocks round(Matter ÷10) off it per action (Matter under 5 scratches nothing). At 0 hp it is gone. The card is spent (no permanent in the holding). Natural: while the copies stand, an enemy whose Matter is below the holder's may not end a move on a hex within 1 of the holder (peer.mjs simulate, after the labyrinth-wall veto, against the holders' tiles before the action's moves; creation_ward_bars) — the move is vetoed (journey blocked), no hit points, nothing to wear down. Monster natural permanent (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_natural_permanents): a monster whose creature card has this innate effect starts with 2 copies already cast — one permanent id in permanents_csv plus a copy count in perm_copies_json, power 6 each (perm_power_json), both cards in its permanents holding (they count toward DECK_MIN), none in its deck, never cast (not in its deck, and destroyed copies are archived, so npcCastChoice never sees it). Rule 24 (a die of 6 of the stat of the effect's elements) destroys ONE copy per success (dropPermanent decrements, the destroyed copy's card goes to the monster's ARCHIVE — out of circulation); the effect lasts until both are gone. Wild monsters only (no companion / summon / human or npc_b hero); a restart / rejoin boots with exactly 2 again. Players still cast it as described first; the natural reading applies only to a monster's starting copies.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
The wall goes on a right-clicked adjacent tile (q, r at distance 1).

effects.description: What an enemy moving into the obstacle knocks off it: round(Matter ÷10).
Natural: an enemy with less Matter may not enter a hex next to the holder.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys ONE copy when it is at least 6.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_earth (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The natural_permanent block (copies, power, semantics) stays.
